_comment: The one join of every push gate's device (SPEC INV-210/INV-212). Generated by scripts/gen-gates-manifest.py from the four places that already state each part by hand: guardrails/pre-push (letter, law sentence, SPEC anchor, script), guardrails/gate-red-proofs.json (red proof), guardrails/ci-mirror.json (CI carve-out), and .github/workflows/gates.yml (whether the letter is mirrored). No field here is typed by a person — this file is output only, exactly like guardrails/tree-counts.json's generated blocks, and guardrails/check-gates-manifest.py (gate af) reds a committed copy that differs from a fresh build, or a gates.yml step whose law sentence differs from the `law` field here. It does NOT generate any gate's executable check: pre-push stays the live script that runs every gate, unsimplified.

a.law: fresh prover record for today (one record per push: the re-check of the spec and the architecture, and the adversarial read of the pushed range, SPEC M-6/INV-116/INV-304)

b.law: test suite green (scoped by the diff's reach, SPEC INV-45)

c.law: every spec anchor owned by exactly one architecture node
c.mirror_reason: Folded into the test suite: tests/test_traceability.py asserts anchor ownership and runs inside the pytest step (gate b), so this check is already covered in CI.
c.proof: Gate c invokes no check of its own: pre-push echoes a note pointing at the pytest suite. The anchor-ownership assertion tests/test_traceability.py::test_architecture_owns_every_anchor_once rides the suite (gate b), whose red-proof tests/test_guardrails.py::test_broken_suite_fails shows the suite reds on a broken assertion. This mirrors the CI carve-out ci-mirror.json already declares for gate c (folded into the test suite).

d.law: TEST_MATRIX.md generated Reference agrees with the body (SPEC INV-273/INV-218)

h.law: the four host checks (this repo attached as its own first host, SPEC INV-97)

i.law: shipped-language (no owner name or stray Cyrillic in the shipped set, SPEC INV-120)

j.law: no broad browser-kill (cleanup targets the test resource only, SPEC INV-162)

k.law: compaction freeze (guarded docs' anchor map / markers / numbers unchanged, 2.0)
k.mirror_reason: The compaction freeze reads a gitignored local baseline (.spec-freeze/) that a fresh CI checkout does not carry.

l.law: muted browser launch (every browser-driving script launches muted, SPEC INV-157)

m.law: config health (installed hooks match guardrails/ source, SPEC INV-175)
m.mirror_reason: config-health compares the installed personal hooks against their source; a CI checkout installs no such hooks by design and the check skips itself by name.

n.law: the earned message (an agent's inbox deposit names its birth, SPEC INV-189)

o.law: cleanup notice (every cleanup path that ends a process says what it ended, SPEC INV-204)

p.law: touchpoint kind (a surface speaks only the kind its touchpoint affords, SPEC INV-205)

q.law: waiting list (the board loses nothing — no over-cap shown set, no demotion into the void, SPEC INV-206)

r.law: authority anchor (a decision recorded as the person's names its exchange, SPEC INV-207)

s.law: skill review (a substantive skill change carries its skill-creator review record, SPEC INV-208)

t.law: doc rotation (the pack's split-and-rotated docs lose nothing — every rotated row is findable in its archive and every archive is named in a manifest line, SPEC INV-209)

u.law: CI mirror parity (every local gate is mirrored in CI or a declared carve-out, SPEC INV-210)

v.law: judges listed (every wired chat judge is referenced in the installed settings.json, SPEC INV-211)
v.mirror_reason: The judge-listed gate reads the personal-layer ~/.claude/settings.json, absent on a CI checkout; it stands down by name there, exactly as config-health (m) skips.

w.law: every gate can fail (every gate in this chain carries a known-red proof, SPEC INV-212)

x.law: generated index (the committed index equals a fresh build off the body; body and index agree; an empty body reds by name, SPEC INV-258/INV-259/INV-218)

y.law: agent card (a live-spec host tree carries its .live-spec/agent.md card, SPEC INV-219)

aa.law: doc findings bound (no live document above its recorded finding count; a cleared document stays at zero, SPEC INV-301)

ad.law: published tree counts (every count this repository publishes about its own tree matches the tree, and the reproduction command beside it returns the published number, SPEC INV-305)

ae.law: named checks (the registry says what each runnable file a skill body names is, SPEC INV-306)

af.law: gate device manifest (guardrails/gates-manifest.json joins every gate's script, red proof and CI-mirror status from pre-push, gate-red-proofs.json and ci-mirror.json; it reds where a fresh build differs from the committed file, or where a gates.yml step's law sentence differs from the gate's own, SPEC INV-210/INV-212)
